_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

defectCodeName.description: Display value of defectCodeId, copied from u_mes_qual_defectCode.name

wipUnitName.description: Display value of wipUnitId, copied from u_mes_plan_wipUnit.recordNo

serialNumberName.description: Display value of serialNumberId, copied from u_mes_trac_serialNumber.recordNo

lotName.description: Display value of lotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

productVariantName.description: Display value of productVariantId, copied from u_mes_prod_productVariant.name

productionOrderName.description: Display value of productionOrderId, copied from u_mes_plan_productionOrder.recordNo

detectedAtOperationId.description: Reference to u_mes_prod_operation._id: detected at operation

detectedAtOperationName.description: Display value of detectedAtOperationId, copied from u_mes_prod_operation.name

detectedAtWorkCenterId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_workCenter._id: detected at work center

detectedAtWorkCenterName.description: Display value of detectedAtWorkCenterId, copied from u_mes_mast_workCenter.name

originOperationName.description: Display value of originOperationId, copied from u_mes_prod_operation.name

defectLocationText.description: Location description, e.g. Bore B edge

operatorUserName.description: Display value of operatorUserId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_equipment.name

componentLotName.description: Display value of componentLotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

operationExecutionName.description: Display value of operationExecutionId, copied from u_mes_plan_operationExecution.recordNo

inspectionResultName.description: Display value of inspectionResultId, copied from u_mes_qual_inspectionResult.recordNo

shiftName.description: Display value of shiftId, copied from u_mes_mast_shift.name

detectedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'detected'

detectedBy.description: Display name of the user in detectedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

imageControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_controlledDocument._id: image controlled document

imageControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of imageControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_syst_controlledDocument.title

nonconformanceName.description: Display value of nonconformanceId, copied from u_mes_qual_nonconformance.title

reworkOrderName.description: Display value of reworkOrderId, copied from u_mes_qual_reworkOrder.recordNo

scrapRecordName.description: Display value of scrapRecordId, copied from u_mes_qual_scrapRecord.recordNo

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
